dataset.description: Fictional private account activity, generated entirely from authored synthetic inputs.

sources.description: Fictional contents, identities, and activity; no collection from any source.

generation.method: Deterministic varied study calendar with chronological Core replay of imports, annotation updates, collection edits and citation exports

transformations: Replay actual App tools through PALE Core; project stable activity records and a separately loadable final snapshot.

review.notes: Separate review candidate. No third-party content or real user activity.
